channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: JetBlue ending direct flights from Vero Beach to JFK Airport in September
item.description: JetBlue is ending its direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport, citing low passenger demand for the route that launched in December.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff ramps up traffic enforcement with 1,162 stops in four weeks
item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county. item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters, adopters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: Murray Middle School demolition begins in Martin County after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Demolition is underway at Murray Middle School in Martin County, starting a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage from Hurricane Milton.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers Florida homeowners rates by 5.6 percent
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6 percent, the latest in a series of rate decreases the Florida-based company has made over the last two years.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis Jr. introduced as Miami Heat players in standing ovation at Kaseya Center

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season against Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes
item.description: The Florida Panthers will begin their regular season on the road with four Western Conference games, opening against the 2026 Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes on Sept. 29.

item.title: Four Panthers Finnish players make Lantana Finland House a hockey hotspot
item.description: The Finland Club in Lantana on Finlandia Boulevard has become a celebration center for fans of Panthers Finnish stars Aleksander Barkov, Anton Lundell, Niko Mikkola and Eetu Luostarinen.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts finish top 15 at AAU Nationals, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month.

item.title: Argentina scores late to beat England 2-1, advances to World Cup final against Spain
item.description: Argentina rallied from trailing 1-0 in the 85th minute to defeat England 2-1 Wednesday with goals from Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez, advancing to the World Cup final against Spain on Sunday.

item.title: Spain defeats France 2-0 to reach first World Cup final since 2010
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain defeated France 2-0 Tuesday to advance to its first World Cup final since winning in 2010.

item.title: Photograph of Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal surfaces before World Cup final
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort took photos in 2007 of a teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in a plastic bathtub for a charity calendar, nearly two decades before they face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa deals
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched the Downtown Delray Wellness Pass for July and August, allowing users to access complimentary classes, discounted wellness treatments and promotions from participating businesses.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 daily meals to children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach supports more than 35 Summer BreakSpot sites across Palm Beach County, serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children while school is out for the summer.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program offers summer volunteer opportunities for South Florida families
item.description: The TLC Program at B'nai Torah Congregation provides hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking, literacy efforts and care for seniors.

item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free summer promotion through August 10
item.description: Palm Beach Zoo has extended its popular Kids Free promotion through Aug. 10, allowing up to four children ages 3 to 12 to receive free admission with the purchase of one adult ticket.

item.title: Donalds, Jolly Lead Florida Governor's Race as Primary Enters Final Stretch
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly have emerged as frontrunners in Florida's gubernatorial primary race as the August 18 primary approaches. item.title: Florida Fentanyl Summit in Orlando Draws Teens, Grieving Parents and DEA Chief
item.description: Students from anti-drug coalitions across the country joined federal law enforcement at a Florida summit this week to address the ongoing fentanyl crisis.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:
Registration is now open for Port St. Lucie City University, a free nine-session program designed to help residents better understand how their local government operates.
